string-array.name: faq_questions
string-array.item: What actions are required for the app to function properly?
Why are the above permissions needed, and are they safe for users?
Can I set up multiple apps at the same time?
How do I know if the desired app has started timing?
How can I check if \"Accessibility\" is enabled?
Will the app still work normally when \"Time Management\" is turned off?

string-array.name: faq_answers
string-array.item: You need to grant three permissions: \"Usage Stats\", \"Accessibility\", and \"Notification\" for the app to work properly.

With the \"Usage Stats\" permission, the app can know which apps are installed on your phone. With the \"Accessibility\" permission, the app can detect when apps are opened or closed in real time. With the \"Notification\" permission, the app can notify users. These permissions are not intended to track or collect users personal information.
The free version currently supports only 1 app. To use multiple apps, you need to upgrade to Premium.

When the app you want to track is opened, you will receive a notification that it has started; when closed, you will also get a notification. If no notification appears, it means the \"Accessibility\" permission is missing.

The simplest way is to go to the \"Personal\" section of the app, then tap \"Go to Accessibility\", find the \"Time Management\" app, and turn it on. Note: the status of the app must be \"On\". If not, try toggling the permission off and on again. If that doesn\’t work, reset the app so it can function again.
All data is stored locally on your device. We do not collect or store any personal data on servers.
Yes, the app will continue counting down even if you don\’t open it.
